name: jixoai-theme
title: jixoai theme
description: The jixoai design-language token sheet: OKLCH colors with the one-brand-hue law, hard offset shadows, radius 0 with bevel upgrade, mono-first fonts, terminal surfaces, and the reveal hook styles.
docs: Install delivers the full token sheet as a css FILE (jixoai.css). No cssVars are injected: injection overwrote existing brand hues and produced mangled mappings on projects that already carried a token sheet.
